question: Should OpenClaw continue supporting the legacy `skills/skill-creator/scripts/init_skill.py --resources` helper, or close the linked PR and this issue as obsolete now that current main routes durable skill creation through `skill_workshop`?
rationale: Automation can verify the latest release helper rejects mixed-case resources and the open PR fixes that old surface, but current main removed the helper and the repository guidance now points durable skill creation at Skill Workshop, which is a maintainer product-boundary choice.

options.title: Close Obsolete Cluster
options.body: Close the open PR and this issue together, documenting that current main no longer supports the helper and `skill_workshop` is the supported path.

options.title: Refresh Helper Repair
options.body: Ask for or create a refreshed PR that intentionally restores or maintains the helper, adds the mixed-case parser tests, and explains the supported release/backport story.

recommendation.title: Close Obsolete Cluster
recommendation.body: Close the open PR and this issue together, documenting that current main no longer supports the helper and `skill_workshop` is the supported path.

likelyOwner.reason: The original bundled skill helper was introduced in steipete-authored history, so the legacy helper support decision routes most directly there.
